docs(arc42): responsibilities only, no implementation details

## Intent

The architecture's check CLI element again described implementation details. State what each part is accountable for and why; details belong in the code, the help texts and the skills.

## Key changes

- bb-check-cli says what the check CLI is accountable for: every check of an app, the same command everywhere, a built app or a deployed address as a learner meets it, explainer pages also without JavaScript, the entry against the app, every finding with its rule.
- A sweep of docs/arc42 removes client-module wording, a named comment command and other details; the evidence table's derived facts name no paths, flags, packages or environment variables, while its source column keeps its sources.
